scope: Article argument through a spring calculation and Hamiltonian-learning construction.
method: Deterministic local rendering; separate native WebVTT captions; no generative video API.
synthetic_narration: Supertonic 2 F1; local inference; disclosed in video and article.
audio_rights: MIT inference code; BigScience OpenRAIL-M model. Model section6 disclaims output rights except as stated; use restrictions apply. AttachmentA(e) requires synthetic-content disclosure, supplied in video and transcript. No macOS system-voice recording is included.
numeric_conditions: Normalized h=0.1, 2000 steps, q0=1,u0=0. Teaching calculation, not a matched-cost benchmark.

interpretation_limits.model: Undamped undriven horizontal linear spring, fixed mass and stiffness.
interpretation_limits.comparison_scope: Same h teaching calculation, not an equal-cost or equal-accuracy benchmark.
interpretation_limits.HNN: Smooth autonomous learned function in canonical coordinates; Hamilton equations conserve it in continuous time. Learned physical accuracy and discrete integration error remain separate tests.

human_review: No human listening, pronunciation or reader-comprehension study.

article_player_checks.browsers: Chrome 155 headless, desktop 1440 and mobile viewport 390, landscape 844×390; not a physical-device study.
article_player_checks.initial_state: Paused, controls/playsinline, preload none, no autoplay or loop.
article_player_checks.captions: Default language WebVTT showing; lower caption band preserves scientific labels, dense scenes and three longest cues checked per language.
article_player_checks.controls: Play/pause, first/middle/end seeking, end/replay, collapse pauses; container fullscreen enter/exit button and app Escape handler.
article_player_checks.reduced_motion: Static poster first; explicit manual reveal; no autoplay.
article_player_checks.accessibility: Visual transcript and MP4/VTT/TXT downloads, no document overflow or missing images.
article_player_checks.audio_scope: Browser playback checked muted. Full PCM signal/decode checks passed; no human listening/pronunciation/comprehension study.
article_player_checks.pdf: KO15 and EN18 pages, all pages visually checked; final render, text and annotations identical after web CSS change; no private-path or attachment leak.
article_player_checks.independent_caption_visual_review: Passed for bilingual dense scenes and longest cues, inline and container fullscreen; meaningful scientific labels remain visible.

publication_checks.archive: Local review, archive and public-site PDF copies are byte-identical.
